title: Unused-media check runs only through pre-commit
answers: where is the unused media check run in CI
how to run unused media check locally
which workflow checks for unused media files
body:
The unused-media check (`dev/find-unused-media.sh`) is no longer a dedicated step in `.github/workflows/lint.yml`.
It runs as the `unused-media` hook in `.pre-commit-config.yaml`, and CI invokes it via `pre-commit run --all-files`.
To run it locally, use `pre-commit run unused-media --all-files` or run the script directly.
To change its behavior, edit the hook entry in `.pre-commit-config.yaml`, not `lint.yml`.
applies: Anyone changing media-file linting or the CI lint workflow in this repo.
